objective: Summarize measured readiness from actual available artifacts.

summarize-readiness-metrics.expected_when: An explicit project_root is supplied and the routine is due.
summarize-readiness-metrics.acceptance: Produces working/readiness-dashboard.md from provided evidence and states blockers and limitations.
summarize-readiness-metrics.fallback: Write a blocker artifact; never infer missing evidence.
summarize-readiness-metrics.recovery: Re-read current project inputs and continue within this eligible run.
